title: Define rights & consent boundaries

authorities.walletAuthorization: 420 Wallet / SmartAccount for explicit user signatures/actions
authorities.voicePersonaConsent: no canonical production registry is claimed by HZ-GCA-1.6; only qualified explicit consent references may be consumed
authorities.hzRole: collect intent, display requirements, preserve references, fail closed, and submit only bounded requests to owning systems

HUMAN: no AI-specific transformation or synthetic-identity consent is implied solely by HUMAN disclosure
AI_ASSISTED: if source Work/Recording material is actually used, the applicable Creative permissions still apply
if a synthetic identifiable voice/persona is used, explicit consent references are required
AI_GENERATED: ordinary Creative registration/rights/contributor requirements apply for claimed human contributors/rights holders
synthetic identifiable voice/persona use requires explicit consent references
model/provider execution does not confer copyright, contributor or commercialization rights
AI_DERIVATIVE: Creative AI_TRANSFORM plus USE_MASTER and COMMERCIALIZE permissions are required for the canonical AI_DERIVATIVE source-recording path unless a later Creative policy version changes the exact required mask
a valid source license may satisfy recording permissions only through Creative LicenseRegistry.hasPermissions semantics
synthetic identifiable voice/persona use additionally requires explicit consent references

licenseRules: Creative LicenseRegistry may satisfy required source-recording permissions only for the exact active licenseeProfileId, source RecordingId, permission mask and validity window.
Expired, inactive, wrong-licensee, wrong-recording or insufficient-mask licenses fail closed.
420Hz cannot infer permission from existence of a license offer, payment receipt, metadata label or provider claim.
Derivative activation must be revalidated by the Creative Protocol at activation time; preflight approval in 420Hz is not final authority.
contributorRules: A proposed Creative contributor credit is not accepted consent or attribution.
Only ContributorRegistry credit state ACCEPTED establishes accepted protocol credit for that exact asset/role.
Contributor credit is distinct from economic rights ownership; RightsRegistry split/finalization controls economic rights.
Economic rights ownership is distinct from source-use authorization and distinct from synthetic voice/persona consent.
420Hz may not auto-accept contributor credits, fabricate rights splits or infer rights from display metadata.
rightsRules: Creative Work and Recording rights remain separate canonical pools.
Initial splits require the canonical RightsRegistry acceptance/finalization path.
RightsStatus metadata does not itself replace finalized RightsRegistry split state.
A generation provider, AI model creator, Compute worker or storage provider receives no Creative rights merely by participating in execution.
Awards/community popularity never changes Creative rights.

rules: AI_TRANSFORM permission authorizes a transformation use under Creative policy only; it does not authorize model training.
AI training rights fail closed under 420AI unless the model/version training mode and valid grant authorize the exact grantee/scope.
An ordinary Creative licensePolicyId, remix license, contributor credit or rights split does not imply AI training permission.
A 420AI training grant does not authorize transformation, remix, sampling, commercialization or use of a Creative Work/Recording.

voicePersonaConsent.scope: synthetic or cloned voice/persona claims that identify or purport to identify a real performer/creator/person
requiredEvidence: scope commitment covering the intended synthetic use
evidence commitment/reference that can be independently checked by the qualified consent source
rules: A typed name, artist name, model name, prompt text, provider badge, user checkbox without qualified evidence, or public availability of recordings is not consent.

Consent must be scoped to the intended synthetic identity use; generic contributor credit or source-license permission is insufficient unless that canonical instrument explicitly covers the synthetic identity scope.
Consent expiry or revocation blocks new REVIEWED/REGISTERED/PUBLISHED transitions requiring that consent.
Historical provenance retains the consent reference/status observed at publication even if later revoked.

Because the repository does not currently establish a canonical production voice/persona consent registry for this HZ phase, 420Hz must fail closed for such claims unless a qualified explicit consent source/reference is available.

sourceMaterialRules: Reference audio that contains protected Work/Recording material must follow Creative source authorization; upload possession alone is not permission.
USE_MASTER, USE_STEMS, USE_SAMPLE and AI_TRANSFORM are distinct permissions and must not be substituted for one another.
A source Work permission cannot satisfy a required source Recording permission where AuthorizationRegistry420 requires both.
Public-domain or independently-owned source assertions require provenance/evidence; 420Hz does not self-certify legal status.
External processing permission, where relevant, remains separate from Creative derivative permission.

beforeSUBMITTED: creator must acknowledge applicable source/voice rights requirements for the intended request
known disallowed source/persona use must fail before paid execution where determinable
beforeREVIEWED: HZ-GCA-1.5 provenance is complete for the selected output
synthetic identifiable voice/persona claims have qualified consent references
beforeREGISTERED: required source authorization/license state is revalidated
accepted contributor credits/rights setup required by Creative activation workflow are not fabricated by 420Hz
authorizationManifestCommitment binds the exact rights/consent references used
beforePUBLISHED: Creative Work/Recording activation requirements pass canonically
derivative authorization is valid at activation/publication time
required voice/persona consent remains valid for the publication action

expiryRevocationRevalidation: Time-bounded source licenses and consent instruments must be checked at the action that relies on them, not merely when first uploaded.
Revocation cannot retroactively erase immutable historical provenance but can block new generation, registration, publication, republication or derivative actions according to policy.
Cached authorization/consent status is non-authoritative and must not outlive its source freshness/validity.
If canonical source state is unavailable or conflicting, the gated action fails closed.
failureRules: AI_DERIVATIVE without required Creative authorization fails closed.
Required synthetic voice/persona consent without qualified explicit evidence fails closed.
Contributor PROPOSED is not treated as ACCEPTED.
Unfinalized rights split is not treated as finalized economic rights.
Creative AI_TRANSFORM is never treated as AI training permission.
420AI TrainingGrant is never treated as Creative transformation/commercialization permission.
Provider/model/user assertions cannot substitute for canonical authorization or qualified consent.
Missing/unavailable/conflicting required authority state blocks the action rather than defaulting to allowed.
invariants: HZGCA-RC-001 420Hz never becomes the canonical authority for Creative rights, licenses, contributor credits, AI training grants or wallet authorization
HZGCA-RC-002 AI_DERIVATIVE requires canonical Creative source authorization and cannot be authorized by disclosure/provenance labels alone
HZGCA-RC-003 Creative AI_TRANSFORM permission and 420AI training permission are independent and non-substitutable
HZGCA-RC-004 source Recording permission masks are checked exactly for the derivative class and cannot be broadened by 420Hz
HZGCA-RC-005 an issued Creative license is usable only when active, unexpired, correct-licensee, correct-source and sufficient-mask
HZGCA-RC-006 derivative authorization is revalidated by the Creative Protocol at activation rather than trusted from stale application preflight
HZGCA-RC-007 contributor credit requires ContributorRegistry ACCEPTED state; PROPOSED is insufficient
HZGCA-RC-008 accepted contributor credit does not imply economic rights ownership
HZGCA-RC-009 finalized economic rights do not imply source-use authorization or synthetic identity consent
HZGCA-RC-010 AI providers, models, workers and storage providers acquire no Creative rights by execution participation alone
HZGCA-RC-011 synthetic identifiable voice/persona use requires explicit scoped consent evidence from a qualified source
HZGCA-RC-012 names, prompts, model labels, provider claims, public recordings and unverified checkboxes are not consent
HZGCA-RC-013 consent/source authorization expiry or revocation blocks new gated actions that rely on it
HZGCA-RC-014 historical provenance preserves prior authorization/consent references without converting revoked consent into current permission
HZGCA-RC-015 reference-audio possession is not authorization; source Work/Recording permissions remain distinct
HZGCA-RC-016 missing, unavailable or conflicting required rights/consent state fails closed
HZGCA-RC-017 rights/consent checks cannot be bypassed by HUMAN/AI_ASSISTED/AI_GENERATED disclosure selection
HZGCA-RC-018 authorizationManifestCommitment binds exact source/consent references but does not itself grant the underlying authority
exitCriteria: rights, contributor, source-use, AI-training and voice/persona consent authorities are explicitly separated
canonical Creative derivative permission masks and license validation boundaries are preserved
AI transformation and AI training permission are explicitly non-substitutable
synthetic voice/persona consent evidence requirements and fail-closed absence behavior are explicit
lifecycle revalidation, expiry/revocation and historical-provenance semantics are explicit
machine verifier enforces authority separation, exact permission vocabulary and fail-closed invariants
no nonexistent consent registry, ABI, deployment, provider or testnet state is claimed
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.7 through HZ-GCA-1.20
